default.p.70.outline.1.label: A new job using a katakana name

default.p.71.outline.1.label: Comparing gift-giving cultures: one's own country and Japan

default.p.71.outline.2.label: Positive effects of giving gifts

default.p.71.outline.3.label: The author's determination
